Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১) Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability of getting the sum of the face number is odd?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
In a simultaneous throw of two dice, we have n(S) = 6 x 6 = 36
Let E = event of getting two numbers whose sum is odd.
Then E = {(1,2), (1,4), (1,6), (2,1), (2,3), (2,5), (3,2), (3,4), (3,6), (4,1), (4,3), (4,5), (5,2), (5,4), (5,6), (6,1), (6,3), (6,5)}
therefore, n(E) = 18
And P(E) = p( getting two numbers whose sum is odd)
P(E)= n(E)/n(S)
= 18/36
= 1/2

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২) A five-digit number is formed by using digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 without repetition. What is the probability that the number is divisible by 4?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
A number divisible by 4 formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 has to have the last two digits 12 or 24 or 32 or 52.
In each of these cases, the five digits number can be formed using the remaining 3 digits in 3! = 6 ways.
A number divisible by 4 can be formed in 6 × 4 = 24 ways.
Total number that can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 without repetition
= 5! = 120
Required probability,
= 24/120
= 1/5

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ৩) You toss a coin AND roll a die. What is the probability of getting a tail and a 4 on the die?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Probability of getting a tail when a single coin is tossed 
=1/2
Probability of getting 4 when a die is thrown 
=1/6
Required probability,
=1/2 × 1/6
=1/12

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ৪) One card is drawn at random from a pack of 52 cards. What is the probability that the card drawn is a face card?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Clearly, there are 52 cards, out of which there are 12 face cards 4 jack, 4 queens, and 4 kings
∴ P (getting a face card) 
= 12/52
= 3/13

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ৫) One card is drawn from a pack of 52 cards. What is the probability that the card drawn is either a red card or a king?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Here, n(S) = 52
There are 26 red cards (including 2 kings) and there are 2 more kings.
Let E = event of getting a red card or a king.
Then, n(E) = 28
∴P(E)=n(E)/n(S)
=28/52
=7/13

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ৬) In a simultaneous throw of two dice, what is the probability of getting a total of 10 or 11?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
In a simultaneous throw of two dice, we have n (S) = (6 × 6) = 36
Let E = event of getting a total of 10 or 11
= [(4, 6), (5, 5), (6, 4), (5, 6), (6, 5)]
∴P(E) = n(E)/n(S) = 5/36

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১২) In how many different ways can the letters of the word ‘BAKERY’ be arranged?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
The letters of the word 'BAKERY' be arranged in 6! ways 
= 6!
= 6 × 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1
= 720

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৩) In how many ways can the letters of the word ‘MOMENT’ be arranged?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
There are six letters in the given word MOMENT and letter 'M' has come twice.
∴ Required number of ways
= 6!/ 2!
= (6×5×4×3×2×1)/ (2×1)
= 360

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৪) In how many ways can a group of 5 men and 2 women be made out of a total of 7 men and 3 women?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Required number of ways
= (7C5×3C2)
= (7C2×3C1)
= (7×6 /2×1)×3
= 63

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৫) How many natural numbers less than a lakh can be formed with the digits 0,6 and 9?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
The digits to be used are 0,6 and 9
The required numbers are from 1 to 99999
The numbers are five digit numbers.
Therefore, every place can be filled by 0, 6 and 9 in 3 ways.
Total number of ways = 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 3 = 35
But 00000 is also a number formed and has to be excluded.
Total number of numbers,
= 35 - 1
= 243 - 1
= 242

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৬) In how many ways can six different rings be worn on four fingers of one hand?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Required number of ways,
= 6C4
= 6×5×4! /2!4!
= 15 ways

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৭) How many ways can 4 prizes be given away to 3 boys, if each boy is eligible for all the prizes?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Let the 3 boys be B1, B2, B3 and 4 prizes be P1, P2, P3 and P4
Now B1 is eligible to receive any of the 4 available prizes (so 4 ways)
B2 will receive prize from rest 3 available prizes(so 3 ways)
B3 will receive his prize from the rest 2 prizes available(so 2 ways)
So total ways would be: 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 = 24 Ways
Hence, the 4 prizes can be distributed in 24 ways

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৮) The number of positive integers which can be formed by using any number of digits from 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 without repetition.
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
One digit positive numbers = 5
Two digit positive numbers = 25
Three digit positive numbers = 100
4 digit positive numbers = 300
5 digit positive numbers = 600
Six digit positive numbers = 600
Total positive numbers,
= 5 + 25 + 100 + 300 + 600 + 600
= 1630

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ১৯) Three gentlemen and three ladies are candidates for two vacancies. A voter has to vote for two candidates. In how many ways can one cast his vote?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
There are 6 candidates and a voter has to vote for any two of them.
So, the required number of ways is,
= 6C2
= 6!/ 2!×4!
= 15

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২০) In how many ways 4 boys and 3 girls can be seated in a row so that they are alternate.
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Let the Arrangement be,
B G B G B G B
4 boys can be seated in 4! Ways
Girl can be seated in 3! Ways
Required number of ways,
= 4! × 3!
= 144

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২১) Today is Monday. After 61 days, it will be:
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Each day of the week is repeated after 7 days.
So, after 63 days, it will be Monday.
∴ After 61 days, it will be Saturday.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২২) How many days are there in x weeks x days?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp: x weeks x days = (7x + x) days = 8x days.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৩) The last day of a century cannot be
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
100 years contain 5 odd days.
∴ Last day of 1st century is Friday.
200 years contain (5 x 2) ≡ 3 odd days.
∴ Last day of 2nd century is Wednesday.
300 years contain (5 x 3) = 15 ≡ 1 odd day.
∴ Last day of 3rd century is Monday.
400 years contain 0 odd day.
∴ Last day of 4th century is Sunday.
This cycle is repeated.
∴ Last day of a century cannot be Tuesday or Thursday or Saturday.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৪) Which of the following is not a leap year?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
The century divisible by 400 is a leap year.
∴ The year 700 is not a leap year.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৫) January 1, 2008 is Tuesday. What day of the week lies on Jan 1, 2009?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
The year 2008 is a leap year. So, it has 2 odd days.
1st day of the year 2008 is Tuesday (Given)
So, 1st day of the year 2009 is 2 days beyond Tuesday.
Hence, it will be Thursday.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৬) If today is Monday, what will be the day 350 days from now?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp: 350 days, 350/7 = 50, no odd days, so it will be a Monday.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৭) The angle between the minute hand and the hour hand of a clock when the time is 4:20, is:
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
Angle traced by hour hand in 13/ 3 hrs
=( 360/12 × 13/3)∘ =130∘
Angle traced by min. hand in 20 min
=( 360/60 ×20)∘=120∘
∴Required angle
=(130−120)∘ =10∘

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৮) How many times are the hands of a clock at right angle in a day?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
In 12 hours, they are at right angles 22 times.
∴ In 24 hours, they are at right angles 44 times.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ২৯) How many times in a day, are the hands of a clock in straight line but opposite in direction?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp:
The hands of a clock point in opposite directions (in the same straight line) 11 times in every 12 hours. (Because between 5 and 7 they point in opposite directions at 6 o'clcok only).
So, in a day, the hands point in the opposite directions 22 times.

Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.question: ৩০) Through what angle does the minute hand of a clock turn in 5 minutes?
Calender & Clock, Permutation & Combinat.exp: Angle traced by the minute hand in 5 minutes. =(360/60×5)∘ = 30∘
